title: Export
intro: When you click the button below WordPress creates an XML file (WXR) for you to save to your computer, containing posts, pages, comments, custom fields, categories and tags. Backdrop separates content from configuration and exports each differently.

sections.heading: Configuration export (site structure and settings)
sections.text: Everything that is not content: content types, fields, views, layouts, menus, roles, settings. Exported as JSON, one file per configuration item.

sections.heading: Content export
sections.text: Backdrop core has no content exporter; use a View with a data export display, or Bee on the command line (bee db-export for a full database dump).

links.title: Bee CLI
links.description: bee db-export writes a database dump
